caption: The drawing depicts a single stoneware jug with a narrow neck, a rounded body, and a single curved handle attached from the shoulder to the neck. The color of the jug is a muted beige or tan, with blue decorative elements. On the front of the jug, there is a blue painted illustration that features two seated human silhouettes in a small boat, with one figure holding a pole, appearing to paddle. Above these figures, there is a curved line of small blue dots forming an arc, and directly above this, a stylized blue flower with leaves is depicted, with the flower facing outward and its stem curving downwards. The background is plain and cream-colored, and there are no additional objects or decorations within the drawing.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
